design.rationale_block_count: C(8,4)=70 permutations -> min exact p = 1/70 = 0.0143 < 0.05. With 4 blocks C(4,2)=6 -> min p = 0.167, unreachable.

analysis.rationale_for_penalization: With 8 blocks per subject, each training fold has ~6 blocks while FS_B has 14 features. Unpenalized logistic regression would hit complete separation, producing diverging coefficients and artificially high AUC that cannot be distinguished from real signal. A fixed-strength L2 penalty guarantees finite coefficients. Strength is PRESPECIFIED, not tuned: tuning would require nested CV that 6 training blocks cannot support. See [V63] (penalized methods help when events are few).
analysis.known_limitation: lambda=1.0 on z-scored features is a convention, not an optimum. It is frozen before data collection so that it cannot be chosen to favour a result.

permutation_test.why_primary: The ENTIRE pipeline (standardization, penalized fit, CV, AUC) is re-run on each permuted label assignment. Any optimism from small-sample fitting inflates AUC under permuted labels too, so it is absorbed by the null distribution. This is what makes the result trustworthy despite the small block count.

descriptive_thresholds.note: Secondary. Computed out-of-fold. Used to judge practical magnitude, NOT significance.

prespecified_thresholds.justification_for_0_70: Phase1 observed chance-level for current features (0.442-0.507) and 0.60-0.68 for the strongest simple signal (keys->Q2). A deliberately induced high-friction condition must exceed the best naturally observed weak signal.

separation_diagnostic.note: If perfect training separation still occurs under the fixed L2 penalty, report it. Do not silently pass.

manipulation_check.reason_not_in_app: probe_scheduler.rs is frozen; also 1-5 Likert caused straight-lining in Phase1 (P013)

prespecified_exclusions.block_level: only technical log loss (keystroke log missing or truncated); rule frozen before data collection

prereg.note: G1 is a new gate introduced after the v0.3 preregistration was frozen. Section 3 of README.md must be separately preregistered before execution (researcher decision).
